ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$. Points $D$ and $C$ are on $\odot O$. Connect $AD$, $DC$, $AC$. If $\angle C=65^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle BAD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect BD.\\
Since $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ADB=90^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle C=65^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABD=65^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAD=90^\circ-65^\circ=\boxed{25^\circ}$.
